title: Suspicions Concerning Miss Mana Semenovna Artemieff, Russian

VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.4058.                                SHANGHAI,    6th December 1937 .

letter of the 4th instant, No.D.8201, concerning

                              I have the honour to be,
                                        Sir,
                              Your obedient servant,

                              for Acting Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
                        SHANGHAI.

December 4 37.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No. 3867 dated 22nd November, 1937,
and in reply to inform you that there is nothing
in Municipal Police records detrimental to the
character of Miss Maria Semenowna Artemieff. A copy
of report concerning her is attached.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

The Acting Consul-General,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

— — — Miss Maria Leonovna ARTEMIEFF, Russian, was born on
February 2, 1910 in Transbaikal Province, Siberia. She is report-
ed to have left Russia for China in 1918 and to have resided
until 1923 at the Manchouli Station, Chinese Eastern Railway,
where her father, who is reported to be in the U.S.S.R. at present,
was employed in the local gaol as a warder.
In 1923 Miss Artemieff arrived in Shanghai and has
since been residing in this city with her sister, Miss Antonina
J. Artemieff. For the last several years the two sisters are re-
ported to have been working as professional dancing partners in
local cabarets, mostly at the Delmorte Cafe, Avenue Haig.
On November 11, 1937 Miss W. Artemieff registered with
the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Poulmein Road, on the
strength of Residential Permit No 398 issued on 24-8-37 by the
Chefoo Police Headquarters.
While in Shanghai she did not come to the notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of an un-
desirable character.
(签名)
D. S. I.
D. C. ( Special Branch )

— — — 玛丽亚·列昂诺芙娜·阿尔捷米耶夫小姐（Miss Maria Leonovna ARTEMIEFF），俄国人，1910年2月2日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省。据报她于1918年离开俄国前往中国，并在1923年前一直居住在中东铁路满洲里站，其父亲当时在该地监狱担任看守，据报目前身在苏联。
1923年，阿尔捷米耶夫小姐抵达上海，此后一直与其姐姐安东尼娜·J.阿尔捷米耶夫小姐（Miss Antonina J. Artemieff）居住在本市。据报，在过去几年中，两姐妹在当地舞厅担任职业舞伴，主要在海格路（Avenue Haig）的德尔莫特咖啡馆（Delmorte Cafe）。
1937年11月11日，W.阿尔捷米耶夫小姐凭烟台警察总局于1937年8月24日签发的第398号居住证，在蒲石路118/1号俄国侨民委员会进行了登记。
在上海期间，她未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。
(签名)
D. S. I.
副督察长（特别课）

page_data.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3867                                SHANGHAI,    22 November, 1937.

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that Miss Maria ARTENIEVA
has applied to this Consulate for a visé for admission into
the Netherlands-Indies.
    Miss Artenieva is not yet in possession of a passport.
    She is born in Bakalsky Province (Russia) at February 19,
1910, and intends to visit the Netherlands Indies where she
will contract a marriage with Mr. Leeuwe, an engineer engaged
with the Royal Packet Navigation Company.
    A passage with the Java China Japan Line has been paid
and she intends to leave on board the s.s."Tjisondari"at
December 8, 1937.
    She resides at 403 Avenue du Roi Albert.
    I should be much obliged to you, if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against the person
from a political or moral point of view.

                                    I have the honour to be,
                                                Sir,
                                    Your obedient-servant,

                                    Act. Consul General.

The Deputy Commisioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
            SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第3867号                                上海，1937年11月22日。

先生：

    谨此告知，玛丽亚·阿尔捷尼耶娃小姐（Miss Maria ARTENIEVA）已向本领事馆申请前往荷属东印度的入境签证。
    阿尔捷尼耶娃小姐目前尚未持有护照。
    她于1910年2月19日出生于（俄国）巴卡尔斯基省（Bakalsky Province），拟前往荷属东印度，并将在那里与皇家邮船导航公司（Royal Packet Navigation Company）的工程师柳乌先生（Mr. Leeuwe）结婚。
    已支付爪哇-中国-日本航线（Java China Japan Line）的船票费用，她计划于1937年12月8日乘坐“芝宋达里”号轮船（s.s."Tjisondari"）启程。
    她居住在阿尔伯特王路403号（403 Avenue du Roi Albert）。
    如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否有任何对该人不利的记录，我将不胜感激。

                                    谨致，
                                                先生，
                                    您顺从的仆人，

                                    代总领事。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别课副督察长，
            上海。

（左侧手写批注：* 搜查与记录部门无既往记录）
